summary: This file imports a custom remark plugin called remarkSnippetLoader and then exports a configuration object that registers this plugin with a documentation/blog preset. The plugin will run before any default remark processing happens, allowing it to transform markdown content first.

explanations.2: This imports a custom plugin file from a local directory that extends remark (a markdown processor) with snippet-loading functionality.
explanations.12: This array tells the build system to run our custom plugins before running the standard markdown processing plugins, ensuring our snippet loader transforms the content first.
explanations.15: This adds our imported plugin to the list of custom processors that should run early in the markdown transformation pipeline.
